overview: The Community Development Board reviewed proposals for a mixed-use building on Salem Street, a large research laboratory on Commercial Street, and an auto glass repair shop. All three public hearings were continued to the April 3rd meeting to allow for plan revisions and to resolve procedural errors.

items.title: 290 Salem Street Mixed-Use Development
items.summary: Continued the public hearing for a three-story mixed-use building with seven residential units to April 3. The board voted to send an advisory memo to the Zoning Board of Appeals indicating support for dimensional variances based on current design revisions.

items.title: 48-64 Commercial Street Fellsway Innovation Center
items.summary: Continued the site plan review for a proposed 97,857-square-foot research and testing laboratory to April 3. The applicant will submit revised plans addressing city engineering comments regarding parking islands, stormwater management, and pedestrian access.

items.title: 294 Harvard Street Special Permit
items.summary: Continued the special permit application for an auto glass repair establishment to April 3 to correct a procedural address error on the meeting agenda. The board reached a consensus on conditions for approval including the removal of barbed wire and specific signage standards.

items.title: Minutes and Administrative Updates
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the February 21, 2024 meeting and postponed a discussion regarding zoning overhaul updates.
